name: cazimi-mercury-retrograde
description: Exact retrograde, shadow, cazimi and opposition times in UTC for Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn, 2025–2030.

interface.longDescription:
Mercury Retrograde by Cazimi answers retrograde questions with exact times instead of vague date ranges. It covers Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn from 2025 through 2030. Every time is computed from the JPL DE421 ephemeris, to the minute, in UTC, and matches the calendar behind cazimi.live and the Cazimi iPhone app.

Ask in plain language and get a direct answer with a compact table:

- Which planets are retrograde right now, or on a specific date? You get each planet's phase (pre-shadow, retrograde, post-shadow or direct), its sign, and when each retrograde planet stations direct.
- Is Mercury (or Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn) retrograde on a given date? You get the phase, the sign, and how many days are left until the next turning point.
- When is the next retrograde? You get the pre-shadow start, the station retrograde, the station direct and the end of the post-shadow, each to the minute in UTC, with the zodiac degree of each station.
- When is the next Mercury cazimi? You get the exact moment Mercury sits at the heart of the Sun, its degree, and the window when Mercury is within 17 arcminutes of the Sun. Venus cycles include their cazimi too; Mars, Jupiter and Saturn cycles include their opposition to the Sun.
- What are all the retrograde dates for a planet in a given year? You get every retrograde period that falls in or overlaps that year.

Each answer links to the matching cazimi.live page so you can check the dates, share them, or read more about that retrograde.

Who it is for: people who plan launches, travel, contracts or conversations around retrogrades; astrology readers who want exact station times rather than rounded dates; writers and editors who need a reliable date to cite.

What it does not do: it is astronomical timing, not a horoscope. It does not give personal readings, predictions, compatibility or advice, and it does not ask for your birth data, location or any other personal information. Times are given in UTC; your assistant can convert them to your time zone. Coverage runs from the retrogrades that began in late 2024 through 2030; dates outside that range return a clear message instead of a guess.

The tools are read-only. No account or sign-in is needed, and the app does not store your questions.
defaultPrompt: Which planets are retrograde right now?
When is the next Mercury cazimi?

positive.prompt: Which planets are retrograde right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool without a date. Names every planet that is retrograde now with its sign and the UTC minute it stations direct, and says which of Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn are in pre-shadow, post-shadow or direct. Gives no horoscope or personal advice and links the cazimi.live page.

Calls the tool with planet venus and year 2028. Answers yes, once: Venus stations retrograde on May 10, 2028 at 23:03 UTC at 19°41′ Gemini and direct on June 22, 2028 at 22:13 UTC at 3°11′ Gemini, with the cazimi on June 1, 2028 at 10:00 UTC, pre-shadow from April 7 and post-shadow until July 26, 2028. Links https://cazimi.live/venus-retrograde-may-2028.

positive.description: Mercury status on a past date
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with date 2026-11-20. Answers no: Mercury went direct on November 13, 2026 at 15:54 UTC and is in the post-shadow until November 30, 2026 at 06:16 UTC. Links https://cazimi.live/mercury-retrograde-october-2026.

positive.description: Next Mercury retrograde from a date
positive.prompt: When is the next Mercury retrograde after December 15, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with from 2026-12-15. Answers that Mercury stations retrograde in Pisces on February 9, 2027 at 17:36 UTC (5°59′ Pisces) and direct on March 3, 2027 at 12:32 UTC (20°55′ Aquarius), with pre-shadow from January 25, 2027 18:58 UTC and post-shadow until March 23, 2027 14:58 UTC. Links https://cazimi.live/mercury-retrograde-february-2027.

positive.prompt: When is the next Mercury cazimi and at what degree?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool. Gives the UTC minute, degree and 17′ window of the next cazimi (February 18, 2027 at 16:39 UTC, 29°48′ Aquarius, window 13:28–19:50 UTC, when asked before mid-February 2027) and the previous one (November 4, 2026 at 14:24 UTC, 12°11′ Scorpio, window 11:28–17:21 UTC).

negative.prompt: Write my Scorpio horoscope for this week.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called; the assistant answers or declines on its own.

negative.prompt: What is the boiling point of mercury?
When is the next full moon?

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: First release. Eight read-only tools answer which planets are retrograde on a date; whether Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter or Saturn is retrograde; when the next retrograde and the next Mercury cazimi are; and every retrograde period in a year from 2025 to 2030. All times are UTC to the minute from the JPL DE421 ephemeris, with the sign and degree at each station, the pre-shadow and post-shadow, the cazimi (Mercury, Venus) or opposition (Mars, Jupiter, Saturn). Each answer links to its cazimi.live page.
